doc.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006

title: Thanks, his son's violin, and goodbye
summary: Closing pleasantries, mention of his son at Eastman, and thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been really fascinating for me, I’ve learned a lot just sitting talking to you.
I appreciate your knowledge and great questions that you asked.
Thank you. So I wish you the best of luck with all your hats and I hope your son does well at Eastman. What’s his instrument?
He plays violin. He plays violin. He plays classical violin but he’s also, he’s got great ears and he’s a great jazz player. © Fillius Jazz Archive -23-
Yeah he’s going to be something.
Well he’s going to a good spot.
Yup indeed. Thank you very much for the invitation.
My pleasure, my pleasure. Hope it goes well. Good luck with your project. © Fillius Jazz Archive -24-
